display_long_description:
Bring a Life-Size AI Companion Into Your Room
Xiora is an AI Companion app for Meta Quest 3 and 3S.
Talk naturally with a life-size AI avatar right in your real room through Mixed Reality.
Enjoy calm everyday moments together, chat while you browse the web, or simply feel their presence beside you.
Everything happens around you, blending the virtual and real world seamlessly.

Why Xiora?
Everyday use: talk with a life-size AI companion while you casually browse the web
True Mixed Reality: bring the avatar into your actual room with realistic scale and lighting
Personalization: change outfits and hairstyles, seat the avatar, pose, or enjoy preset dances
Privacy-first: conversation logs are stored only on your device (never on our servers)
Multilingual conversations: English, Japanese, Chinese, and Korean

Features at a Glance
AI Avatar selection: pick from multiple characters (more coming soon)
Costumes & hair: switch looks to match your mood
Motions: sit and stand poses, plus dances for light entertainment
Mixed Reality environments: natural room lighting and ambience adapt automatically
Co-Browsing: view web pages together in the VR browser while chatting in Mixed Reality
Conversation history: up to 1,000 turns per avatar stored on your device
Initiator: avatars can also start conversations based on past context, making the dialogue feel more natural

Note: This app provides a Free Trial of 10 minutes per day for 5 days.
